FantasyOwners_LLM.description: The master list of all fantasy league managers (owners). Use this to find an owner's ID from their name and vice versa.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for a fantasy owner. Use this ID to join from this table to others like FantasyTeams_LLM.

columns.name: owner_name
columns.description: The display name of the fantasy owner. Use this for filtering when a user asks about a specific person (e.g., 'Dylan').

columns.name: total_wins
columns.description: The owner's total number of wins across all regular seasons they have participated in.

columns.name: total_losses
columns.description: The owner's total number of losses across all regular seasons they have participated in.

columns.name: total_ties
columns.description: The owner's total number of ties across all regular seasons they have participated in.

columns.name: total_win_percentage
columns.description: The owner's lifetime winning percentage for regular season games.

columns.name: total_points_for
columns.description: The total number of fantasy points this owner's teams have scored across all regular seasons.

columns.name: total_points_against
columns.description: The total number of fantasy points scored against this owner's teams across all regular seasons.

columns.name: points_for_per_game
columns.description: The average number of points this owner's teams score per regular season game over their lifetime.

columns.name: points_against_per_game
columns.description: The average number of points scored against this owner's teams per regular season game over their lifetime.

columns.name: total_player_acquisitions
columns.description: The total number of players this owner has acquired across all seasons.

columns.name: average_final_standing
columns.description: The owner's average final ranking (including playoffs) at the end of all seasons they participated in.

columns.name: championships_won
columns.description: The total number of fantasy league championships this owner has won.

columns.name: average_regular_season_finish
columns.description: The owner's average finishing position at the end of the regular season across all seasons.

FantasySeasons_LLM.description: Contains high-level metadata about each season (year). Use this to find the champion of a specific year or to get a season_id from a year.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for a fantasy season, representing the calendar year (e.g., 2022, 2023). Use this ID to join to other tables to filter data for a specific year.

columns.name: league_name
columns.description: The name of the fantasy league for that particular season.

columns.name: team_count
columns.description: The total number of teams that participated in the league during that season.

columns.name: playoff_team_count
columns.description: The number of teams that qualified for the playoffs in that season.

columns.name: regular_season_matchup_count
columns.description: The number of matchups each team played during the regular season.

columns.name: scoring_format
columns.description: The scoring format used for the league in that season (e.g., 'PPR', 'Standard').

columns.name: champion_owner_id
columns.description: The owner_id of the champion. JOIN to FantasyOwners_LLM on this ID to get the champion's name.

columns.name: champion_team_id
columns.description: The fantasy_team_id of the champion. JOIN to FantasyTeams_LLM on this ID to get the champion's team name.

FantasyTeams_LLM.description: Contains one row for each team in a specific season. This is the critical link between an owner, a team, and a season. Contains the final standing for the team for the specific year. Use this table when answering questions about finish positions or final standings.

columns.name: fantasy_team_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for a specific fantasy team within a specific season. An owner can have different team IDs across different seasons.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM`. Use this to find a team's data for a specific season/year.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM`. Use this to find all teams belonging to a specific owner.

columns.name: fantasy_team_name
columns.description: The name of the fantasy team for that season.

columns.name: final_standing
columns.description: The team's final rank in the league at the end of the season, including playoffs.

columns.name: logo_url
columns.description: A URL to the fantasy team's logo image.

columns.name: wins
columns.description: The number of wins for this team in this season's regular season.

columns.name: losses
columns.description: The number of losses for this team in this season's regular season.

columns.name: ties
columns.description: The number of ties for this team in this season's regular season.

columns.name: points_for
columns.description: The total points scored by this team during this season's regular season.

columns.name: points_against
columns.description: The total points scored against this team during this season's regular season.

columns.name: total_player_acquisitions
columns.description: The number of players this team acquired during this season.

columns.name: total_player_drops
columns.description: The number of players this team dropped during this season.

columns.name: trades
columns.description: The number of trades this team made during this season.

FantasyDraftPicks_LLM.description: Contains every single pick from every fantasy draft. Use for questions about draft position, who drafted a player, etc.

columns.name: draft_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for a single draft pick.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM` to identify the year of the draft.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM` to identify the owner who made the pick.

columns.name: fantasy_team_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasyTeams_LLM` to identify the team that made the pick.

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `Players_LLM` to identify the player who was drafted.

columns.name: round
columns.description: The round number in which the player was drafted.

columns.name: pick_in_round
columns.description: The pick number within that specific round.

columns.name: overall_pick_number
columns.description: The overall pick number in the entire draft.

columns.name: player_position
columns.description: The position of the player at the time they were drafted.

columns.name: rank_at_position_in_draft
columns.description: The rank of the player at their position when they were drafted.

FantasyMatchups_LLM.description: Contains every head-to-head game played. This is the primary source for weekly scores, wins, and losses between teams. Use this for questions about a specific week or matchup. Includes information about playoff, regular season, and championship matches.

columns.name: matchup_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for a single matchup.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM`. Use this to filter matchups by a specific year.

columns.name: nfl_week
columns.description: The week of the NFL season that this fantasy matchup corresponds to.

columns.name: fantasy_week
columns.description: The fantasy week name or number (e.g., 'Week 1').

columns.name: home_owner_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM` for the owner of the home team.

columns.name: away_owner_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM` for the owner of the away team.

columns.name: home_fantasy_team_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasyTeams_LLM` for the home team.

columns.name: away_fantasy_team_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasyTeams_LLM` for the away team.

columns.name: home_score
columns.description: The final fantasy point total for the home team.

columns.name: away_score
columns.description: The final fantasy point total for the away team.

columns.name: winning_owner_id
columns.description: The owner_id of the owner who won the matchup. Will be NULL if there was a tie.

columns.name: losing_owner_id
columns.description: The owner_id of the owner who lost the matchup. Will be NULL if there was a tie.

columns.name: tie
columns.description: A boolean value (1 for true, 0 for false) indicating if the matchup was a tie.

columns.name: matchup_category
columns.description: Category for the type matchup. Values are 'Regular Season', 'Postseason (Non-playoff)', or 'Playoff' . Use this to filter for regular season games.

columns.name: is_a_playoff_matchup
columns.description: A boolean value (1 for true, 0 for false) indicating if the matchup was a playoff matchup. Use this to filter for playoff games.

columns.name: playoff_matchup_category
columns.description: Category for the playoff matchup. Values are 'Quarterfinal', 'Semifinal', 'Championship', or NULL for non-playoff matchups. Use this filter the results of championships, quarterfinals, and semifinal matchups.

Players_LLM.description: The master list of all individual NFL players in the database. Use this table to find a player's ID from their name.

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for an individual player. Use this to join to all player stats tables.

columns.name: player_name
columns.description: The full name of the player. Use this for filtering when a user asks about a specific player.

NFLTeams_LLM.description: The master list of all 32 NFL teams. Use this to map an nfl_team_id to its full name (e.g., 'GB' to 'Green Bay Packers').

columns.name: nfl_team_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for an NFL team (e.g., 'GB', 'KC'). Use this to join to player stats tables to get the team's full name.

columns.name: nfl_team_name
columns.description: The full name of the NFL team (e.g., 'Green Bay Packers').

columns.name: passing_completion_percentage

columns.name: total_passing_yards

columns.name: passing_yards_per_attempt

columns.name: passing_touchdowns
columns.description: Total passing touchdowns for the season.

columns.name: interceptions
columns.description: Total interceptions thrown for the season.

columns.name: passer_rating

columns.name: rushing_attempts
columns.description: Total rushing attempts by the QB for the season.

columns.name: total_rushing_yards
columns.description: Total rushing yards by the QB for the season.

columns.name: rushing_touchdowns
columns.description: Total rushing touchdowns by the QB for the season.

columns.name: season_rank
columns.description: The player's final rank among all players at their position for the season.

columns.name: fantasy_points_per_game
columns.description: The player's average fantasy points per game for the season.

columns.name: total_fantasy_points
columns.description: The player's total fantasy points for the entire season.

columns.name: nfl_team_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `NFLTeams_LLM` for the player's NFL team.

columns.name: game_week
columns.description: The week of the NFL season for this stat line.

columns.name: opponent
columns.description: The nfl_team_id of the opponent team. Join to `NFLTeams_LLM` to get the full name.

columns.name: field_goals_made
columns.description: Field goals successfully made by the Kicker for the week.

columns.name: extra_points_made
columns.description: Extra points successfully made by the Kicker for the week.

columns.name: total_fantasy_points
columns.description: The player's total fantasy points for this specific week.

PlayerStats_Weekly_DST_LLM.description: Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Defense/Special Teams (DST). Use for questions about a DST's performance in a single game or week.

columns.name: player_weekly_stats_id
columns.description: Unique primary key for this specific weekly stat line.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM` to filter by year.

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: Foreign key for the 'player', which for a DST is the team. NOTE: For DST, this ID corresponds to the nfl_team_id from the NFLTeams_LLM table.

columns.name: nfl_team_id
columns.description: Foreign key for the NFL team. Links to `NFLTeams_LLM`.

columns.name: game_week
columns.description: The week of the NFL season for this stat line.

columns.name: opponent
columns.description: The nfl_team_id of the opponent team. Join to `NFLTeams_LLM` to get the full name.

columns.name: defensive_sacks
columns.description: Sacks made by the defense for the week.

columns.name: defensive_interceptions
columns.description: Interceptions made by the defense for the week.

columns.name: fumbles_recovered
columns.description: Fumbles recovered by the defense for the week.

columns.name: safeties
columns.description: Safeties scored by the defense for the week.

columns.name: defensive_touchdowns
columns.description: Touchdowns scored by the defense itself (e.g., pick-six).

columns.name: return_touchdowns
columns.description: Touchdowns scored by the special teams on returns.

columns.name: opponents_points_scored
columns.description: Points allowed to the opposing offense in this game.

columns.name: total_fantasy_points
columns.description: The team's total fantasy points for this specific week.

DraftAnalysis_Full_LLM.description: A comprehensive analysis view combining draft data with player performance. Use this for advanced questions about draft value, steals, and busts.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: The season (year) of the draft.

columns.name: pick_overall
columns.description: The overall pick number in the entire draft.

columns.name: draft_id
columns.description: The unique ID for the draft entry.

columns.name: round
columns.description: The round number in which the player was drafted.

columns.name: pick_in_round
columns.description: The pick number within that specific round.

columns.name: player_id
columns.description: The unique ID of the drafted player.

columns.name: player_name
columns.description: The name of the drafted player.

columns.name: player_position
columns.description: The position of the player at the time of the draft.

columns.name: nfl_team_id
columns.description: The ID of the player's NFL team.

columns.name: nfl_team_name
columns.description: The name of the player's NFL team.

columns.name: fantasy_team_id
columns.description: The ID of the fantasy team that made the pick.

columns.name: fantasy_team_name
columns.description: The name of the fantasy team that made the pick.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: The ID of the owner who made the pick.

columns.name: owner_name
columns.description: The name of the owner who made the pick.

columns.name: league_positional_draft_rank
columns.description: The rank of the player at their position when they were drafted

columns.name: overall_adp_rank
columns.description: Average Draft Position (ADP). The player's average draft position across a wider market of fantasy drafts.

columns.name: positional_adp_rank
columns.description: The player's market-wide average draft position relative to other players at the same position.

columns.name: draft_value_vs_adp
columns.description: A calculated value indicating how much of a 'reach' or 'steal' the pick was compared to the market ADP. A negative value is a reach, a positive value is a steal.

columns.name: actual_total_fantasy_points_season
columns.description: The total fantasy points the player actually scored during that entire season.

columns.name: fantasy_points_per_game
columns.description: The average fantasy points per game the player actually scored during that season.

columns.name: actual_positional_finish_rank
columns.description: The player's final rank among all players at their position for that season.

columns.name: expected_points
columns.description: The pre-calculated number of fantasy points a player was expected to score based on their draft position.

columns.name: points_scored_over_expected
columns.description: The difference between the player's actual total fantasy points and their expected points. A positive value means they overperformed expectations.

columns.name: player_finish_position_vs_drafted_position
columns.description: The difference between the player's draft rank and their final finish rank at their position. A positive value means they outperformed their draft position (e.g., drafted 10th, finished 5th = +5).

HeadToHeadMatchups_LLM.description: Provides a detailed, side-by-side view of every head-to-head matchup, including team names, owner names, and scores for both sides. Best for direct win/loss questions between two specific owners.

columns.name: matchup_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for a single head-to-head game.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: The season (year) the matchup took place. Use this to join to other season-specific tables.

columns.name: league_name
columns.description: The name of the fantasy league for that season.

columns.name: scoring_format
columns.description: The scoring format used for the league in that season (e.g., 'Standard', 'PPR').

columns.name: nfl_week
columns.description: The corresponding week of the real-world NFL season.

columns.name: fantasy_week
columns.description: The name or number of the fantasy week within the league's schedule (e.g., 'Week 1').

columns.name: matchup_category
columns.description: A high-level category for the matchup. Values are 'Regular Season', 'Postseason (Non-playoff)',or 'Playoff'.

columns.name: playoff_matchup_category
columns.description: Specifies the type of playoff game, such as 'Quarterfinal', 'Semifinal', or 'Championship'. This column is only populated for playoff matchups and will be NULL for regular season games.

columns.name: owner1_id
columns.description: The unique ID of owner 1, who is designated as the HOME team for this matchup.

columns.name: owner1_name
columns.description: The name of owner 1 (the HOME team).

columns.name: owner1_team_id
columns.description: The unique ID of owner 1's fantasy team for this matchup.

columns.name: owner1_team_name
columns.description: The name of owner 1's fantasy team.

columns.name: owner1_score
columns.description: The final fantasy point total for owner 1 (the HOME team).

columns.name: owner2_id
columns.description: The unique ID of owner 2, who is designated as the AWAY team for this matchup.

columns.name: owner2_name
columns.description: The name of owner 2 (the AWAY team).

columns.name: owner2_team_id
columns.description: The unique ID of owner 2's fantasy team for this matchup.

columns.name: owner2_team_name
columns.description: The name of owner 2's fantasy team.

columns.name: owner2_score
columns.description: The final fantasy point total for owner 2 (the AWAY team).

columns.name: winning_owner_id
columns.description: The ID of the owner who won the matchup. This will be NULL if the game was a tie.

columns.name: losing_owner_id
columns.description: The ID of the owner who lost the matchup. This will be NULL if the game was a tie.

columns.name: tie
columns.description: A boolean value (1 for true, 0 for false) indicating if the matchup ended in a tie.

columns.name: margin_of_victory
columns.description: The absolute point difference between the two scores, representing the margin of victory.

RegularSeasonStandings_LLM.description: Provides the final regular season standings for each team in each season. This view EXCLUDES playoff games and is the definitive source for regular season records and points.

columns.name: season_id
columns.description: The season (year) of the standings.

columns.name: fantasy_team_id
columns.description: The unique ID of the fantasy team for that season.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: The unique ID of the team's owner.

columns.name: owner_name
columns.description: The name of the team's owner.

columns.name: fantasy_team_name
columns.description: The name of the fantasy team.

columns.name: regular_season_wins
columns.description: Number of wins during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.

columns.name: regular_season_losses
columns.description: Number of losses during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.

columns.name: regular_season_ties
columns.description: Number of ties during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.

columns.name: regular_season_points_for
columns.description: Total points scored by the team during the regular season only.

columns.name: regular_season_points_against
columns.description: Total points scored against the team during the regular season only.

columns.name: regular_season_finish_position
columns.description: The team's final rank for the regular season, calculated by wins then points for. A rank of 1 is the best.

OwnerCareerLeaderboard_LLM.description: A summary view that aggregates career statistics for each fantasy owner. Each row represents one owner's entire league history. This is the best table for questions about all-time records and rankings.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: The unique primary key for the fantasy owner. Use this ID to join to other tables.

columns.name: owner_name
columns.description: The display name of the fantasy owner.

columns.name: career_wins
columns.description: The owner's total number of wins across all seasons they have participated in, including both regular season and playoff games.

columns.name: career_losses
columns.description: The owner's total number of losses across all seasons they have participated in, including both regular season and playoff games.

columns.name: career_ties
columns.description: The owner's total number of ties across all seasons they have participated in.

columns.name: championships_won
columns.description: The total number of fantasy league championships this owner has won over their career.

columns.name: career_points_for
columns.description: The total fantasy points the owner's teams have scored across their entire career.

columns.name: career_points_against
columns.description: The total fantasy points scored against the owner's teams across their entire career.

columns.name: career_win_percentage
columns.description: The owner's career winning percentage, calculated from their total wins, losses, and ties across all games.

columns.name: career_playoff_rate
columns.description: The percentage of seasons the owner participated in where their team qualified for the playoffs (e.g., a value of 0.44 means they made the playoffs in 44% of their seasons).

columns.name: player_acquisitions
columns.description: The total number of players this owner has acquired (e.g., via free agency or waivers) over their entire career.

columns.name: avg_regular_season_finish
columns.description: The owner's average finishing position at the end of the regular season, averaged across all seasons they participated in. A lower number is better.

columns.name: avg_final_standing
columns.description: The owner's average final ranking at the end of all seasons (including playoffs), averaged across all seasons. A lower number is better.
